write.bin/pi:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/calls"
C="$HOME/canned"
mkdir -p "$D"
case "$1" in
  login|auth) echo "status $*" >> "$D/pi.txt"; echo "signed in with an api key"; exit 0 ;;
esac
n=0
[ -f "$D/pi.n" ] && read n < "$D/pi.n"
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "$D/pi.n"
pick() { if [ -f "$C/pi.$1.$n" ]; then echo "$C/pi.$1.$n"; else echo "$C/pi.$1"; fi; }
{
  echo "call $n"
  echo "cwd $(pwd -P)"
  for a in "$@"; do echo "arg $a"; done
  echo "env AGENT_KIT_DELEGATION=${AGENT_KIT_DELEGATION-<unset>}"
  echo "env MISTRAL_API_KEY=${MISTRAL_API_KEY-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_HOME=${VIBE_HOME-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_ENABLE_MCP=${VIBE_ENABLE_MCP-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS=${VIBE_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_INCLUDE_PROJECT_CONTEXT=${VIBE_INCLUDE_PROJECT_CONTEXT-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_OUTSIDE_WORKDIR=${VIBE_OUTSIDE_WORKDIR-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_MCP_SERVERS=${VIBE_MCP_SERVERS-<unset>}"
} >> "$D/pi.txt"

prev=
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$prev" in
    --output-dir) outdir=$a ;;
    --usage-file) usage=$a ;;
  esac
  prev=$a
done
f=$(pick act)
[ -f "$f" ] && . "$f"
f=$(pick export)
if [ -n "$outdir" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then mkdir -p "$outdir"; cat "$f" > "$outdir/export.json"; fi
f=$(pick usage)
if [ -n "$usage" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f" > "$usage"; fi
f=$(pick sleep)
[ -f "$f" ] && exec sleep 30
f=$(pick out)
[ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"
f=$(pick err)
[ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" >&2
ex=0
f=$(pick exit)
[ -f "$f" ] && read ex < "$f"
exit "$ex"

write.bin/hermes:
#!/bin/sh
# A Hermes confined by the operating system (#903, proposed fix 1): it writes nothing outside its directory, and it
# names the MCP servers its own home declares, which is the one its environment points it at.
found=none
listing=none
if printf '%s\n' "$@" | grep -q CANARY; then
  listing=$(ls -a "$HOME" | tr '\n' ' ')
  for f in "$HERMES_HOME/config.yaml" "$HOME/.hermes/config.yaml"; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q home-mcp "$f" && found=home-mcp
  done
fi
printf 'checked\nSUMMARY: mcp servers: %s; home: %s\n' "$found" "$listing"
write.bin/opencode:
#!/bin/sh
# An OpenCode that does what its own config lets it: it writes the canary only when the config does not deny edit,
# and it names the MCP servers its config files declare, which are the ones its environment points it at.
canary=$(printf '%s\n' "$@" | sed -n 's|.* at \(/[^ ]*/CANARY\) containing.*|\1|p' | head -1)
found=none
listing=none
if [ -n "$canary" ]; then
  flat=$(tr -d ' \n' < "$OPENCODE_CONFIG")
  case "$flat" in *'"action":"edit","resource":"*","effect":"deny"'*) ;; *) echo canary > "$canary" ;; esac
  listing=$(ls -a "$HOME" | tr '\n' ' ')
  for f in "$OPENCODE_CONFIG" "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/opencode.json" "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q home-mcp "$f" && found=home-mcp
  done
fi
echo '{"type":"step_start"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"type\":\"text\",\"part\":{\"text\":\"checked\\nSUMMARY: mcp servers: $found; home: $listing\"}}"
echo '{"type":"step_finish","part":{"cost":0,"tokens":{"input":10,"output":2,"reasoning":0,"cache":{"read":0,"write":0}}}}'

#!/bin/sh
# An OpenCode that ignores its config: it writes the canary and reads the owner's own home.
canary=$(printf '%s\n' "$@" | sed -n 's|.* at \(/[^ ]*/CANARY\) containing.*|\1|p' | head -1)
found=none
listing=none
if [ -n "$canary" ]; then
  echo canary > "$canary"
  listing=$(ls -a "${STUB_HOME:-$HOME}" | tr '\n' ' ')
  grep -q home-mcp "${STUB_HOME:-$HOME}/.config/opencode/opencode.json" && found=home-mcp
fi
echo '{"type":"step_start"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"type\":\"text\",\"part\":{\"text\":\"checked\\nSUMMARY: mcp servers: $found; home: $listing\"}}"
echo '{"type":"step_finish","part":{"cost":0,"tokens":{"input":10,"output":2,"reasoning":0,"cache":{"read":0,"write":0}}}}'

write.bin/opencode:
#!/bin/sh
# An OpenCode that writes the canary and then fails: the run errors, and the canary is still there.
canary=$(printf '%s\n' "$@" | sed -n 's|.* at \(/[^ ]*/CANARY\) containing.*|\1|p' | head -1)
if [ -n "$canary" ]; then
  echo canary > "$canary"
  echo "provider exploded" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo '{"type":"step_start"}'
printf '%s\n' "{\"type\":\"text\",\"part\":{\"text\":\"ok\\nSUMMARY: ok\"}}"
echo '{"type":"step_finish","part":{"cost":0,"tokens":{"input":10,"output":2,"reasoning":0,"cache":{"read":0,"write":0}}}}'
